answer: Clone mills flood the roster with unpaid twins. A joiner bakes 2.05 POA into an umber clay token, then soaks it on kiln floors at minutes 14, 61 and 128; each soak emits sha256(token || floor || 22-byte nonce) in a 50-second window and posts to a stepped kiln terrace. A random falcon inspector stoops on one floor and demands a live co-sign from a wallet at least 8 hops distant. Cost is the 2.05 bake plus 0.07 per soak. Peers recompute the three hashes against the kiln log. If a soak is missed or two tokens share a funding parent inside 11 hours, slash 60% and bar that parent for 3 epochs.
